Name: Sophia's Beach and MakeUp retexture for Ohodavi's Anime Mods
Author: Adonyashka
Description:
I decided to make a little addition to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]Ohodavi's Anime Mods[/url], because he forgot to add a retexture for Sophia (from SVE) with Make Up and Sophia in her Swimsuit. I made a swimsuit in style of Megumin from popular anime "Konosuba"﻿ because Sophia likes anime/manga and her swimsuit (in original) is red. I'm not a master of pixel art, so I did what I could.
* To install this addition, just unzip file in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] mod's folder

I hope You enjoyed :P
